title: Week of June 22 — New WORB Week, 4H Day 2 Bull Continuation

worb.note: EXPIRED — June 15-19 WORB ended. NEW WORB sets Monday June 22 from full session high/low. Update current-worb.md after Monday close. Do not use prior week values intraday.
